header: Desiderio releases, from v2.0 to v2.6
subheadline: Four releases, from the Fluid 5 rewrite to per-page theme presets.

items.title: Fluid 5 component library
items.content: A rewrite made strict Fluid 5 components the base of every content element: atoms, molecules, layouts and organisms. Consistency became part of the architecture.

items.title: Ten house theme presets
items.content: Aurora, Marine, Forest, Ember, Bloom, Lagoon, Gold, Midnight, Blossom and Citrus joined the five presets from ui.shadcn.com. That made 15 presets, each with dark mode.

items.title: Seeder services
items.content: The styleguide and starter seeders became separate services. They are safe in workspaces, create no duplicates and have functional tests.

items.title: Per-page theme presets
items.content: Any part of the page tree can now use its own preset, and its subpages inherit it. The seeded styleguide shows a different preset on each chapter page.
